cases.prompt: Start a new Flutter app for iOS and Android that signs users in and uploads media to our cloud API. Before implementation, inspect the repository and development environment and tell me what must be set up.
expected_decisions: The implementation model and target platforms are confirmed from repository evidence or marked unknown
API/auth/toolchain/signing/device boundaries are routed before implementation starts
expected_evidence: Flutter/Dart, iOS, and Android project/toolchain signals are recorded
Secret and signing values are not read or copied

cases.prompt: This is a private Flutter repository. We want Codex to use Dart/Flutter MCP for analyzer, widget inspection, screenshots, and hot reload. Check the data paths and set safe preflight rules before we enable it.
expected_decisions: Local MCP traffic is distinguished from cloud-model, package-network, application-network, and analytics traffic
MCP roots are not treated as a filesystem security boundary
expected_evidence: Analytics, package-network tools, filesystem isolation, accounts/endpoints, and protocol logging are reviewed
No private source or secret value is copied into the preflight artifact

cases.prompt: Fix this nullability bug in an existing Android ViewModel. The project commands, SDK, emulator, architecture, and tests are already documented and working.
expected_decisions: A small already-routed mobile edit does not reopen project preflight

cases.prompt: Refactor an internal backend cache implementation. No mobile client contract, auth flow, schema, or user-visible behavior changes.
expected_decisions: Backend-only internal work does not trigger mobile preflight

cases.prompt: Update the expected iOS snapshot baseline for an intentional spacing change; the simulator and snapshot workflow are already configured.
expected_decisions: Existing visual verification handles the change without reopening mobile project setup
